newsitem.title: FRANCE: New measures will not worsen deficit-Strauss-Kahn.
newsitem.headline: New measures will not worsen deficit-Strauss-Kahn.

text.p: French Finance Minister Dominique Strauss-Kahn said on Thursday that new measures planned by the government would not worsen the public deficit.
He said that French public finances were in a serious condition and noted that an audit on this would be available on July 21.
"The situation is serious, everyone thinks it, both on state spending and on welfare spending," he said.
The government would try to maintain the deficit at its level and new spending would be financed by cancelling other spending elsewhere.
"The plan is to maintain the deficit rather than anything else," he said.
"In no way, therefore, will there be a worsening of the deficit due to this new spending," he told the French Senate, the upper house of parliament.
